functions.name: search_autocomplete
functions.description:

This function uses the index type for entities of the given knowledge graph internally if the ?search variable first occurs at the subject or object position, and the index type for properties otherwise.

PREFIX dbp: <http://dbpedia.org/property/>

PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
SELECT DISTINCT ?grandmother ?grandmotherLabel WHERE {
  dbr:Margaret_of_Valois dbp:mother ?mother .
  ?mother(dbp:mother | dbo:mother) ?grandmother .

}
